xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NatureAndDetailsOfTheActionTak: A matter was taken up before the National Lok Adalat pursuant to a complaint filed by the State of Haryana through the Sub-Divisional Agriculture Officer, Cheeka, under the provisions of the Insecticides Act, 1968 and the rules framed thereunder. The proceedings pertained to an alleged issue relating to a sample of Fipronil 0.3% GR and involved M/s Davindra Khad Bhandar, Cheeka; M/s B.R. Agro Tech Ltd. (Manufacturer); and National Fertilizers Limited in its capacity as marketer.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DetailsOfTheViolationOrContrav: Shri Rohit Kumar, District In-charge, Karnal, appeared on behalf of the NFL. In terms of the order passed by the Hon’ble Lok Adalat, a fine was imposed under Section 29(1) of the Insecticides Act, 1968, without any observation adversely impacting the Company’s ongoing business activities.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:ImpactOnFinancialOrOperationOr:
A monetary fine of ₹10,000/- was imposed.
There is no material impact on the operations or financial position of the Company.
